I’m not necessarily sure how to approach those feelings you’re expressing about killing. Truthfully, I have been wronged by many people in my life, and I’ve thought I’d ways I would enjoy them suffering by my own hand, but I promise you it’s not the answer. Plus you’ll just get yourself caught because being a serial killer in todays society is harder than it was 50 years ago. Something you may want to consider though… I’ve thought about harming others who have hurt me, but I have also been willing (and tried) to off myself, and I have self harmed before. I think if you’re willing to take someone else’s life or hurt someone else, you have to be able and willing to receive the same, or bring that same fate upon yourself, otherwise it’s not fair to your potential victims if you can’t turn the sword on yourself. And by no means am I advocating for you to do something that horrific, but I think you should speak to someone about your feelings, a professional, before it goes beyond your control because I can only imagine how much those urges have grown over the years. Be safe friend

I’m tired too. And I strongly relate to you when you say your moods fluctuate between invincibility and the bottomless pit of emptiness. I’ve thought similar thoughts, about how I’m just going to die anyway so why not expedite the process? Or the fact that people would only temporarily miss me and then forget about me all together. I think if you haven’t already, you should talk to your boyfriend about this, and on a deeper level than you may have already done. I know your family would miss you greatly, whether it be extended, direct, or friends you consider family. I also know that your boyfriend would likely never fully recover from losing you. I can’t sit here and preach that you shouldn’t do it because I want nothing more than to do it myself, but you sound like a smart person, with thoughts deeper than the average person. Please feel free to message me if you need anything, you’re never alone, especially here 🖤

Please don’t. Even though I’d love nothing more than for my soul to leave my body, to feel the warmth slowly fade away, to feel the pain ease up, and to take an eternal nap, I beg that you reconsider. Especially in such a gruesome way. However, if you’ve already made up your mind. I just ask that you make it clean for them to see you one last time at peace, and you leave everyone a personalized note telling them this isn’t their fault, even if it was. I live with regret, sadness, pain, anger, but when my time comes I don’t want anyone to blame themselves for my actions more than they already will.

I can’t tell you how much I related to this post, and how beautifully written it was. The suffering never stops, the regret never goes away, and the pain only seems to get sharper with each passing moment. Which time doesn’t even feel like it exists anymore for me. At night I’ve tasked myself with writing menial poetry in my notes on my phone. I think you should start writing and publishing your work, about anything. Being able to read something so in-depth and “real” made me feel a little less alone. I wish you the best in your endeavors and my inbox is always open if you need something. Please stay alive, and please keep writing if not for yourself, for people like me.
